family_facing_reading: Start with the exact Executive Order text and number.
Identify the constitutional and statutory authority cited in the order.
SHARED_POWER means do not assume the President acts alone; identify the congressional role actually established by law.
COURT_RECORD means look for a real judicial opinion, order, injunction, or docket entry tied to this exact Executive Order rather than treating commentary as a ruling.
APPROPRIATIONS means check whether implementation requires money Congress enacted, limited, conditioned, withheld, or never supplied.
LEARN means explain the separation-of-powers path before scoring the claim.
HOLD until a specific Executive Order and its receipts are bound.

family_posture.message: Show the order. Show the statute. Show the court record. Show the money.

next_input: A specific Executive Order number, title, or claim for replay.
